units.rawText: The sights and sounds of a pitched battle are scarier than anything I've ever seen before.
units.displayText: The sights and sounds of a pitched battle are scarier than anything I've ever seen before.

spans.text: The sights and sounds of a pitched battle are scarier than anything I've ever seen before.

units.rawText: Behind the pall of black smoke hanging in the air, the heavens, dyed red by the fires of war, appear blurred and sinister. Tentacles and guns do their deadly work on the scorched earth that extends into the distance.
units.displayText: Behind the pall of black smoke hanging in the air, the heavens, dyed red by the fires of war, appear blurred and sinister. Tentacles and guns do their deadly work on the scorched earth that extends into the distance.

spans.text: Behind the pall of black smoke hanging in the air, the heavens, dyed red by the fires of war, appear blurred and sinister. Tentacles and guns do their deadly work on the scorched earth that extends into the distance.

units.rawText: We turn our fury into a blade which we stab into the monsters, using it to clear a path forward for us with the last of our strength.
units.displayText: We turn our fury into a blade which we stab into the monsters, using it to clear a path forward for us with the last of our strength.

spans.text: We turn our fury into a blade which we stab into the monsters, using it to clear a path forward for us with the last of our strength.

units.rawText: Our footsteps grow heavier as we carry on, and the stench of blood fills the air.
units.displayText: Our footsteps grow heavier as we carry on, and the stench of blood fills the air.

spans.text: Our footsteps grow heavier as we carry on, and the stench of blood fills the air.

units.rawText: Hands reach out from the rubble, clawing at the sky and at their salvation, but by the time we move the huge rocks pinning them aside, all we find are corpses.
units.displayText: Hands reach out from the rubble, clawing at the sky and at their salvation, but by the time we move the huge rocks pinning them aside, all we find are corpses.

spans.text: Hands reach out from the rubble, clawing at the sky and at their salvation, but by the time we move the huge rocks pinning them aside, all we find are corpses.

units.rawText: Say, Okabe... How long have we been fighting?
units.displayText: Say, Okabe... How long have we been fighting?

spans.text: Say, Okabe... How long have we been fighting?

units.rawText: I don't know...
units.displayText: I don't know...

spans.text: I don't know...

units.rawText: I stopped sensing the flow of time long ago.
units.displayText: I stopped sensing the flow of time long ago.

spans.text: I stopped sensing the flow of time long ago.

units.rawText: What about Undine and the others?
units.displayText: What about Undine and the others?

spans.text: What about Undine and the others?

units.rawText: I think they were badly hurt and were sent back to the Medical Department.
units.displayText: I think they were badly hurt and were sent back to the Medical Department.

spans.text: I think they were badly hurt and were sent back to the Medical Department.

units.rawText: As the battle drags on, the familiar faces helping us vanish one after another.
units.displayText: As the battle drags on, the familiar faces helping us vanish one after another.

spans.text: As the battle drags on, the familiar faces helping us vanish one after another.

units.rawText: Mayuri looks like she wants to say something, but in the end she swallows her words. At some point, the three of us stopped talking to each other in favor of fighting battle after battle along with the Professor's forces.
units.displayText: Mayuri looks like she wants to say something, but in the end she swallows her words. At some point, the three of us stopped talking to each other in favor of fighting battle after battle along with the Professor's forces.

spans.text: Mayuri looks like she wants to say something, but in the end she swallows her words. At some point, the three of us stopped talking to each other in favor of fighting battle after battle along with the Professor's forces.

units.rawText: I hear reports about the battle from time to time. Although my comrade smiles and tells us not to worry, the ever-increasing number of casualties and the growing anxiety of the reports attest to the severity of the situation.
units.displayText: I hear reports about the battle from time to time. Although my comrade smiles and tells us not to worry, the ever-increasing number of casualties and the growing anxiety of the reports attest to the severity of the situation.

spans.text: I hear reports about the battle from time to time. Although my comrade smiles and tells us not to worry, the ever-increasing number of casualties and the growing anxiety of the reports attest to the severity of the situation.

units.rawText: Kurisu and I silently agree not to ask any more questions about this. Right now, all we can do is lighten the burden this battle is placing on my comrade.
units.displayText: Kurisu and I silently agree not to ask any more questions about this. Right now, all we can do is lighten the burden this battle is placing on my comrade.

spans.text: Kurisu and I silently agree not to ask any more questions about this. Right now, all we can do is lighten the burden this battle is placing on my comrade.

units.rawText: Entropics headed your way, 2 o'clock!
units.displayText: Entropics headed your way, 2 o'clock!

spans.text: Entropics headed your way, 2 o'clock!

units.rawText: Alright, then...
units.displayText: Alright, then...

spans.text: Alright, then...

units.rawText: Leave it to me!
units.displayText: Leave it to me!

spans.text: Leave it to me!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hss...</color>
units.displayText: Hss...

spans.text: Hss...

units.rawText: And with that, we've breached their final defensive line...
units.displayText: And with that, we've breached their final defensive line...

spans.text: And with that, we've breached their final defensive line...

units.rawText: Judging from the position of the high-energy irregular data entity we detected just now, the Entropic leader should be just up ahead.
units.displayText: Judging from the position of the high-energy irregular data entity we detected just now, the Entropic leader should be just up ahead.

spans.text: Judging from the position of the high-energy irregular data entity we detected just now, the Entropic leader should be just up ahead.

units.rawText: My comrade does not seem the least bit delighted about this.
units.displayText: My comrade does not seem the least bit delighted about this.

spans.text: My comrade does not seem the least bit delighted about this.

units.rawText: After the long, grueling battle, what remains of my consciousness has been slowly taken up by fatigue.
units.displayText: After the long, grueling battle, what remains of my consciousness has been slowly taken up by fatigue.

spans.text: After the long, grueling battle, what remains of my consciousness has been slowly taken up by fatigue.

units.rawText: The leader of the Entropic horde is right in front of you.
units.displayText: The leader of the Entropic horde is right in front of you.

spans.text: The leader of the Entropic horde is right in front of you.

units.rawText: We paid a painful price to get here... But now, victory is at hand.
units.displayText: We paid a painful price to get here... But now, victory is at hand.

spans.text: We paid a painful price to get here... But now, victory is at hand.

units.rawText: Everyone, take a break and get ready for the upcoming battle!
units.displayText: Everyone, take a break and get ready for the upcoming battle!

spans.text: Everyone, take a break and get ready for the upcoming battle!

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: ...Okabe, are you overexerting yourself?
units.displayText: ...Okabe, are you overexerting yourself?

spans.text: ...Okabe, are you overexerting yourself?

units.rawText: You could have let me handle those Entropics just now...
units.displayText: You could have let me handle those Entropics just now...

spans.text: You could have let me handle those Entropics just now...

units.rawText: I don't answer her right away, instead waving my hands as I reallocate my remaining operands.
units.displayText: I don't answer her right away, instead waving my hands as I reallocate my remaining operands.

spans.text: I don't answer her right away, instead waving my hands as I reallocate my remaining operands.

units.rawText: I've retained my battle experience after shifting from one world line to another. Currently, I'm as familiar with manipulating this power as Kurisu is.
units.displayText: I've retained my battle experience after shifting from one world line to another. Currently, I'm as familiar with manipulating this power as Kurisu is.

spans.text: I've retained my battle experience after shifting from one world line to another. Currently, I'm as familiar with manipulating this power as Kurisu is.

units.rawText: However, my mental fatigue doesn't disappear between shifts.
units.displayText: However, my mental fatigue doesn't disappear between shifts.

spans.text: However, my mental fatigue doesn't disappear between shifts.

units.rawText: I blink, and the sight of Kurisu dying appears in front of me once again.
units.displayText: I blink, and the sight of Kurisu dying appears in front of me once again.

spans.text: I blink, and the sight of Kurisu dying appears in front of me once again.

units.rawText: <size=40>(Heaves)</size>
units.displayText: Heaves

spans.text: Heaves

units.rawText: <size=40>Okabe!</size>
units.displayText: Okabe!

spans.text: Okabe!

units.rawText: ...I'm fine. I told you, I'll protect the two of you, right?
units.displayText: ...I'm fine. I told you, I'll protect the two of you, right?

spans.text: ...I'm fine. I told you, I'll protect the two of you, right?

units.rawText: Okabe, you...
units.displayText: Okabe, you...

spans.text: Okabe, you...

units.rawText: I avoid Kurisu's gaze.
units.displayText: I avoid Kurisu's gaze.

spans.text: I avoid Kurisu's gaze.

units.rawText: Kurisu's instincts are far keener than Mayuri's.
units.displayText: Kurisu's instincts are far keener than Mayuri's.

spans.text: Kurisu's instincts are far keener than Mayuri's.

units.rawText: Since I can't keep them off the battlefield, all I can do is protect them with all my might.
units.displayText: Since I can't keep them off the battlefield, all I can do is protect them with all my might.

spans.text: Since I can't keep them off the battlefield, all I can do is protect them with all my might.

units.rawText: For that reason, I can't do anything which might make them hesitate or feel worried.
units.displayText: For that reason, I can't do anything which might make them hesitate or feel worried.

spans.text: For that reason, I can't do anything which might make them hesitate or feel worried.

units.rawText: Muhahahaha!
units.displayText: Muhahahaha!

spans.text: Muhahahaha!

units.rawText: Please, my dear Christina. I, Hououin Kyouma, am not yet fragile enough to need you to worry about me!
units.displayText: Please, my dear Christina. I, Hououin Kyouma, am not yet fragile enough to need you to worry about me!

spans.text: Please, my dear Christina. I, Hououin Kyouma, am not yet fragile enough to need you to worry about me!

units.rawText: Okarin!
units.displayText: Okarin!

spans.text: Okarin!

units.rawText: Is it your turn now, ditz au naturale?
units.displayText: Is it your turn now, ditz au naturale?

spans.text: Is it your turn now, ditz
au naturale

units.rawText: Like I said just now, I, Hououin Kyou—
units.displayText: Like I said just now, I, Hououin Kyou—

spans.text: Like I said just now, I, Hououin Kyou—

units.rawText: Don't push yourself too hard, 'kay?
units.displayText: Don't push yourself too hard, 'kay?

spans.text: Don't push yourself too hard, 'kay?

units.rawText: This childhood friend of mine whom I've known for over ten years sees through my facade in an instant.
units.displayText: This childhood friend of mine whom I've known for over ten years sees through my facade in an instant.

spans.text: This childhood friend of mine whom I've known for over ten years sees through my facade in an instant.

units.rawText: However, Mayuri does not comment on the matter. Instead, she removes Kurisu's hand from my shoulder to let me rest.
units.displayText: However, Mayuri does not comment on the matter. Instead, she removes Kurisu's hand from my shoulder to let me rest.

spans.text: However, Mayuri does not comment on the matter. Instead, she removes Kurisu's hand from my shoulder to let me rest.

units.rawText: After hesitating for a while, I head over to my comrade's side.
units.displayText: After hesitating for a while, I head over to my comrade's side.

spans.text: After hesitating for a while, I head over to my comrade's side.

units.rawText: Teams 3 and 5, deploy as such...
units.displayText: Teams 3 and 5, deploy as such...

spans.text: Teams 3 and 5, deploy as such...

units.rawText: ...Ah, it's you, Okabe. You've been working hard all this time.
units.displayText: ...Ah, it's you, Okabe. You've been working hard all this time.

spans.text: ...Ah, it's you, Okabe. You've been working hard all this time.

units.rawText: My comrade, I have something that I need to discuss with you... Am I interrupting anything?
units.displayText: My comrade, I have something that I need to discuss with you... Am I interrupting anything?

spans.text: My comrade, I have something that I need to discuss with you... Am I interrupting anything?

units.rawText: Nope, I was just finishing our tactical deployments. As it happens, I wanted to ask you about the enemy leader, too.
units.displayText: Nope, I was just finishing our tactical deployments. As it happens, I wanted to ask you about the enemy leader, too.

spans.text: Nope, I was just finishing our tactical deployments. As it happens, I wanted to ask you about the enemy leader, too.

units.rawText: Do you remember anything about him?
units.displayText: Do you remember anything about him?

spans.text: Do you remember anything about him?

units.rawText: ...Urk!
units.displayText: ...Urk!

spans.text: ...Urk!

units.rawText: That last, tragic scene of Mayuri appears in my mind again.
units.displayText: That last, tragic scene of Mayuri appears in my mind again.

spans.text: That last, tragic scene of Mayuri appears in my mind again.

units.rawText: It hit me so hard that my anger and frustration blanked out pretty much all the details I saw.
units.displayText: It hit me so hard that my anger and frustration blanked out pretty much all the details I saw.

spans.text: It hit me so hard that my anger and frustration blanked out pretty much all the details I saw.

units.rawText: I know it must be a painful memory... Never mind, then. You don't need to force yourself to recall it. No matter what, we'll beat him this time.
units.displayText: I know it must be a painful memory... Never mind, then. You don't need to force yourself to recall it. No matter what, we'll beat him this time.

spans.text: I know it must be a painful memory... Never mind, then. You don't need to force yourself to recall it. No matter what, we'll beat him this time.

units.rawText: ...It's alright, my comrade. I remember a few things.
units.displayText: ...It's alright, my comrade. I remember a few things.

spans.text: ...It's alright, my comrade. I remember a few things.

units.rawText: He was humanoid, but on the small side. He was wearing a hood, so I couldn't see his face...
units.displayText: He was humanoid, but on the small side. He was wearing a hood, so I couldn't see his face...

spans.text: He was humanoid, but on the small side. He was wearing a hood, so I couldn't see his face...

units.rawText: All the humanoid Entropics we've encountered so far tend to be elite units, who are far more powerful than normal... Looks like our opponent will be a tricky one.
units.displayText: All the humanoid Entropics we've encountered so far tend to be elite units, who are far more powerful than normal... Looks like our opponent will be a tricky one.

spans.text: All the humanoid Entropics we've encountered so far tend to be elite units, who are far more powerful than normal... Looks like our opponent will be a tricky one.

units.rawText: Still, there's no need to worry, Okabe. Thank you for sharing this information with me. Was there anything else you wanted to say to me?
units.displayText: Still, there's no need to worry, Okabe. Thank you for sharing this information with me. Was there anything else you wanted to say to me?

spans.text: Still, there's no need to worry, Okabe. Thank you for sharing this information with me. Was there anything else you wanted to say to me?

units.rawText: While I'm reluctant to ask...
units.displayText: While I'm reluctant to ask...

spans.text: While I'm reluctant to ask...

units.rawText: Please assign me to wipe out the Entropic leader, my comrade. I need to see who he is...
units.displayText: Please assign me to wipe out the Entropic leader, my comrade. I need to see who he is...

spans.text: Please assign me to wipe out the Entropic leader, my comrade. I need to see who he is...

units.rawText: I need to know who is the one that's been killing Kurisu over and over again, the one who murdered Mayuri in such a horrible way.
units.displayText: I need to know who is the one that's been killing Kurisu over and over again, the one who murdered Mayuri in such a horrible way.

spans.text: I need to know who is the one that's been killing Kurisu over and over again, the one who murdered Mayuri in such a horrible way.

units.rawText: I feel my clenched fists trembling. The rage coursing through me is so intense that if I were to see him, I would tear him apart.
units.displayText: I feel my clenched fists trembling. The rage coursing through me is so intense that if I were to see him, I would tear him apart.

spans.text: I feel my clenched fists trembling. The rage coursing through me is so intense that if I were to see him, I would tear him apart.

units.rawText: Being constantly overshadowed by him… I will make him pay.
units.displayText: Being constantly overshadowed by him… I will make him pay.

spans.text: Being constantly overshadowed by him… I will make him pay.

units.rawText: ...I understand how you feel, but are you sure you're up for this?
units.displayText: ...I understand how you feel, but are you sure you're up for this?

spans.text: ...I understand how you feel, but are you sure you're up for this?

units.rawText: I'm alright, my comrade. I know how important this battle is; I won't overexert myself.
units.displayText: I'm alright, my comrade. I know how important this battle is; I won't overexert myself.

spans.text: I'm alright, my comrade. I know how important this battle is; I won't overexert myself.

units.rawText: Just trust me, please.
units.displayText: Just trust me, please.

spans.text: Just trust me, please.

units.rawText: My comrade falls silent for a while, and then they pat me on the shoulder.
units.displayText: My comrade falls silent for a while, and then they pat me on the shoulder.

spans.text: My comrade falls silent for a while, and then they pat me on the shoulder.

units.rawText: ...Alright, I'll be there with you.
units.displayText: ...Alright, I'll be there with you.

spans.text: ...Alright, I'll be there with you.

units.rawText: Thank you, my comrade. Also, I have a request...
units.displayText: Thank you, my comrade. Also, I have a request...

spans.text: Thank you, my comrade. Also, I have a request...

units.rawText: Please keep Mayuri and Kurisu far from the battlefield, no matter what you have to do.
units.displayText: Please keep Mayuri and Kurisu far from the battlefield, no matter what you have to do.

spans.text: Please keep Mayuri and Kurisu far from the battlefield, no matter what you have to do.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.
